description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing 70 tools including Prompt, Resource, add_note, add_notes, and 66 more.

tool_signatures.name: Prompt
tool_signatures.description: Description

tool_signatures.name: Resource
tool_signatures.description: URI

tool_signatures.name: add_note
tool_signatures.description: Add a new note to a deck

tool_signatures.name: add_notes
tool_signatures.description: Batch-add up to max_notes_per_batch notes (default 100) sharing the same deck and model. Uses Anki's native batch API for atomic undo. Supports partial success — individual failures don't affect others

tool_signatures.name: card_bury / card_unbury
tool_signatures.description: Hide cards until tomorrow / restore every buried card in a deck

tool_signatures.name: card_change_deck
tool_signatures.description: Move cards to another deck, creating it if needed

tool_signatures.name: card_forget
tool_signatures.description: Reset cards to new

tool_signatures.name: card_reposition
tool_signatures.description: Set the learning order of new cards (only new cards are affected)

tool_signatures.name: card_set_due_date
tool_signatures.description: Reschedule cards with the days DSL (0, 5, 5-7, 5!)

tool_signatures.name: card_set_flag
tool_signatures.description: Set or remove a color flag (0-7)

tool_signatures.name: card_suspend / card_unsuspend
tool_signatures.description: Exclude cards from review indefinitely / restore them

tool_signatures.name: cards_stats
tool_signatures.description: Bulk per-card scheduling stats for a deck (incl. subdecks): type/queue/interval/tags/dueToday, paginated. FSRS-independent, compact payload for analytics

tool_signatures.name: change_note_type
tool_signatures.description: Move existing notes to a different note type, remapping fields by name ({old field: new field or null}). [Destructive](#destructive-tools-opt-in) — hidden unless opted in via enabled_destructive_tools. Two-step flow: dry_run=true returns the resolved plan (mapping, dropped fields, cards removed), then the same call with dry_run=false and confirm=true applies it. All notes must share one source note type

tool_signatures.name: create_deck
tool_signatures.description: Create a new deck

tool_signatures.name: create_model
tool_signatures.description: Create a new note type

tool_signatures.name: delete_media_file
tool_signatures.description: Move a media file to Anki's trash (recoverable via Check Media)

tool_signatures.name: delete_notes
tool_signatures.description: Delete notes from the collection

tool_signatures.name: filtered_deck_delete
tool_signatures.description: Return a filtered deck's cards, then remove the deck

tool_signatures.name: filtered_deck_empty
tool_signatures.description: Return a filtered deck's cards to their home decks

tool_signatures.name: filtered_deck_get_info
tool_signatures.description: Read-only inspection of up to 50 deck IDs per call — returns search terms, limit, order, reschedule flag and card count; non-filtered decks come back with is_filtered=false, unknown IDs are skipped and counted in not_found

tool_signatures.name: filtered_deck_rebuild
tool_signatures.description: Repopulate a filtered deck

tool_signatures.name: filtered_deck_upsert
tool_signatures.description: Create or modify a filtered deck from 1-2 search terms (Anki's hard limit)

tool_signatures.name: find_notes
tool_signatures.description: Search for notes using Anki's search syntax. include_first_field=true adds a noteLabels array ({noteId, firstField, truncated, fullLength}) so you can search and label notes in one call

tool_signatures.name: fsrs_config
tool_signatures.description: anki://fsrs/config

tool_signatures.name: get_card_memory_state
tool_signatures.description: Get FSRS memory state (stability, difficulty, retrievability) for cards

tool_signatures.name: get_due_cards
tool_signatures.description: Get next due card for review (supports skip_images/skip_audio for voice mode). Returns the rendered question only; the answer is omitted unless include_answer=true

tool_signatures.name: get_fsrs_params
tool_signatures.description: Get FSRS scheduler parameters for deck presets

tool_signatures.name: get_media_files_names
tool_signatures.description: List media files matching a pattern

tool_signatures.name: gui_add_cards
tool_signatures.description: Open the Add Cards dialog

tool_signatures.name: gui_answer_card
tool_signatures.description: Press an answer button on the card shown in the reviewer, hands-free rating. [Opt-in](#opt-in-tools) — hidden unless opted in via enabled_opt_in_tools

tool_signatures.name: gui_browse
tool_signatures.description: Open the card browser with a search query

tool_signatures.name: gui_current_card
tool_signatures.description: Get info about the currently displayed card

tool_signatures.name: gui_deck_browser
tool_signatures.description: Navigate to deck browser

tool_signatures.name: gui_deck_review
tool_signatures.description: Open a deck in Anki's own reviewer window. [Opt-in](#opt-in-tools) — hidden unless opted in via enabled_opt_in_tools

tool_signatures.name: gui_edit_note
tool_signatures.description: Open the note editor for a specific note

tool_signatures.name: gui_select_card
tool_signatures.description: Select a specific card in the reviewer

tool_signatures.name: gui_show_answer
tool_signatures.description: Show the answer side of current card

tool_signatures.name: gui_show_question
tool_signatures.description: Show the question side of current card

tool_signatures.name: gui_undo
tool_signatures.description: Undo the last operation

tool_signatures.name: list_decks
tool_signatures.description: List all decks in the collection

tool_signatures.name: model_field_add / model_field_rename / model_field_reposition
tool_signatures.description: Manage fields on an existing note type: add (optionally at a 0-based index), rename (preserves content; card templates are not auto-updated), reposition (reorder). Add and reposition change field ordinals and force a one-way full sync; a pure rename does not. Every result carries will_force_full_sync, the collection's actual (sticky, collection-wide) state after the write

tool_signatures.name: model_field_names
tool_signatures.description: Get field names and descriptions for a note type

tool_signatures.name: model_field_remove
tool_signatures.description: Delete a field and its content from every note of the type. [Destructive](#destructive-tools-opt-in) — hidden unless opted in via enabled_destructive_tools. Forces a one-way full sync

tool_signatures.name: model_names
tool_signatures.description: List available note types

tool_signatures.name: model_styling
tool_signatures.description: Get CSS styling for a note type. include_latex=true also returns the LaTeX preamble (latex_pre, latex_post, latex_svg)

tool_signatures.name: model_templates
tool_signatures.description: Read the Front/Back HTML templates for each card type in a note type

tool_signatures.name: notes_info
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about notes. excerpt_chars caps every field value at that many characters, marking each with truncated/fullLength — a cheap way to survey many notes

tool_signatures.name: optimize_fsrs_params
tool_signatures.description: Run FSRS parameter optimization using Anki's built-in optimizer

tool_signatures.name: present_card
tool_signatures.description: Get card content for review

tool_signatures.name: query_syntax
tool_signatures.description: anki://query-syntax

tool_signatures.name: rate_card
tool_signatures.description: Rate a card after review (Again/Hard/Good/Easy)

tool_signatures.name: review_session
tool_signatures.description: Guided review session workflow. Args: deck_name (default Default), card_limit (default 20), review_style — interactive, quick, voice, or gui

tool_signatures.name: schema
tool_signatures.description: anki://schema

tool_signatures.name: set_fsrs_params
tool_signatures.description: Update FSRS parameters (weights, desired retention, max interval)

tool_signatures.name: stats_collection
tool_signatures.description: anki://stats/collection

tool_signatures.name: stats_forecast
tool_signatures.description: anki://stats/forecast

tool_signatures.name: stats_today
tool_signatures.description: anki://stats/today

tool_signatures.name: store_media_file
tool_signatures.description: Store a media file (image/audio) via base64, file path, or URL. File paths are validated against a media-type allowlist; URLs are checked for SSRF

tool_signatures.name: sync
tool_signatures.description: Synchronize collection with AnkiWeb (asynchronous job: sync() starts a sync, sync(job_id) polls its status, sync(job_id, resolve=...) resolves a full-sync conflict)

tool_signatures.name: system_info
tool_signatures.description: anki://system-info

tool_signatures.name: tag_add / tag_remove
tool_signatures.description: Bulk add/remove tags on notes

tool_signatures.name: tag_batch
tool_signatures.description: Apply multiple add/remove tag operations in one call, with partial success

tool_signatures.name: tag_clear_unused
tool_signatures.description: Remove orphan tags

tool_signatures.name: tag_list
tool_signatures.description: List all tags, or scoped to a deck via the optional deck param — distinct tags on notes with a card in that deck, subdecks included

tool_signatures.name: tag_replace
tool_signatures.description: Swap one tag for another on notes

tool_signatures.name: twenty_rules
tool_signatures.description: Dr. Piotr Woźniak's Twenty Rules of Formulating Knowledge (SuperMemo), as card-authoring guidance for the assistant. No arguments

tool_signatures.name: update_model_styling
tool_signatures.description: Update CSS styling for a note type — full replace, or patch via old_str/new_str (must match exactly once). Can also write the LaTeX preamble (latex_pre/latex_post/latex_svg)

tool_signatures.name: update_model_templates
tool_signatures.description: Update Front/Back template HTML — full replace, or patch via old_str/new_str (must match exactly once). Rejects unrecognized keys (case-sensitive) and unknown template names up front, applying all edits atomically — a failed call leaves the model unchanged

tool_signatures.name: update_note_fields
tool_signatures.description: Update fields of existing notes. Two modes: full replace, or patch via old_str/new_str (find-and-replace within a field; must match exactly once or nothing is written)

tool_signatures.name: update_notes
tool_signatures.description: Batch-update fields of multiple notes in one atomic undo step (single backend call). Validates every entry first; supports partial success up to max_notes_per_batch
